localizedValues.description:
Picnic shelter: 2 braziers, no water or electricity, 2 picnic tables under cover, 5 additional picnic tables in the vicinity.
A special activity permit is required for weddings, large items brought into the park, event rentals, vendors, food trucks, etc. Please contact the park at (360) 877-5361 for information at least 60 days before the event.
